title: Better Raid Bell
description: Increases the bell's raid highlight range from 48 to 128 blocks and glow duration from 3 to 20 seconds - mod was requested on discord will probably not be maintained / updated
body:
A simple Forge mod that slightly increases the vanilla bell's range for raids / pilligers.

All values of the mod are hardcoded and non-configurable as these values were specifically requested via Discord.

**Highlight Range**: 48 blocks > 128 blocks

**Glow Duration**: 3 seconds > 20 seconds
